description: Source code for MCPProtocolClient, a Go implementation managing communication with MCP servers via various protocols (stdio, HTTP). It includes methods for discovering capabilities, initializing connections, and starting MCP server processes for capability discovery.

classes.name: MCPProtocolClient
classes.description: Handles communication with MCP servers, including capability discovery over stdio and HTTP, and starting MCP server processes.

methods.name: NewMCPProtocolClient
methods.description: Creates a new MCP protocol client instance with verbose logging option.

methods.name: DiscoverCapabilitiesFromProcess
methods.description: Discovers MCP server capabilities from a running process, via stdio or HTTP.

methods.name: DiscoverCapabilitiesFromURL
methods.description: Discovers MCP server capabilities from a remote URL, supporting HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: StartMCPServerForDiscovery
methods.description: Starts an MCP server process temporarily for capability discovery, using a command template and environment variables.
